title: NorthWest Paddle Rentals
specs: Self-serve lockbox system for easy pickup and return
Boards can be taken to any lake; Clear Lake and Big Lake nearby
Must be 18 or older to book; adult responsible for equipment and group
Wear a US Coast Guard–approved personal flotation device; kid kits include a vest
Responsible for own safety and supervision of minors; no paddling under influence
Online booking limited to 6 boards; larger groups arranged by contacting operator
includes: Complete paddle board kit including board, paddle, leash, and life vest in kid kits
Boards inspected daily for pressure and safety
blurb: Guests book and pay online to receive a lockbox code for self-serve pickup of complete paddle board kits in Sedro-Woolley. They can paddle at any lake they choose, with boards inspected daily and kits including paddle, leash, and for kids, a life vest. Rentals run May through September, with flexible cancellation and weather policies.
